methodologyNotes: Roster of 12 high-search corded and cordless circular saw models from DeWalt, Milwaukee, Makita, Bosch, Skil/Skilsaw, Ryobi, Ridgid, and Festool. Specs re-verified against manufacturer product pages (dewalt.com, milwaukeetool.com, makitatools.com, festoolusa.com, skil.com) plus authorized dealers (toolnut.com, acmetools.com) and spec aggregators (Grainger, Travers, Zoro, powertools.techreviewer.com) and major retailers (Home Depot, Lowe's, Walmart). Power source is 'corded' or 'cordless'; voltage_or_amps carries rated amperage for corded tools and battery voltage for cordless tools; weight_lb is tool-only unless noted; brushless is a boolean. Prices are current US standard retail / MSRP (bare tool where applicable) and can fluctuate at large retailers. accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: DeWalt DCS577B FlexVolt 60V MAX 7-1/4 in. Cordless Worm Drive Style Circular Saw
products.priceNote: Bare-tool retail price $329.00 per Ohio Power Tool (ohiopowertool.com); Tool Nut lists $341.99 for the same DCS577B. The DeWalt manufacturer page does not publish a price. Prices fluctuate by retailer.
products.provenance: DeWalt's manufacturer page for DCS577B confirms the exact model — "Flexvolt 60V MAX 7-1/4-in. Cordless Worm Drive Style Saw (Tool Only)" — and states 60V battery voltage, Cordless/Battery power source, a 7-1/4 in. blade, "Bevel capacity of 53° with stops at 45° and 22.5°," and an "efficient brushless motor"; it publishes no RPM, weight, release year, or price. Ohio Power Tool's manufacturer-spec table for the same DCS577B corroborates 60 V, 7-1/4 in blade, 53° bevel and brushless motor, and adds the no-load speed (5800 RPM) and weight excluding battery (13.5 lbs / net tool weight 13.5 lbs), with a bare-tool price of $329.00; Tool Nut independently lists the same 13.5 lb weight. No fetched page states a release year, so releaseDate and the release spec are left null.

Circular Saw, tool only — not a sibling: 7-1/4 in blade, 36V (dual 18V LXT), electronically-controlled BL brushless motor delivering 5,100 RPM, and 0-53 deg bevel with positive stops at 22.5/45/53. The manufacturer page (makitatools.com/products/details/XSR01Z) was unreachable from this environment, so the two fetched, mutually corroborating pages are used as source and corroboration; neither explicitly states a product launch year, so releaseDate is left null.

products.name: Makita SP6000J1 6-1/2 in. Plunge Circular Saw Kit with 55 in. Guide Rail
products.priceNote: No numeric US price is displayed on any fetched page: Coastal Tool shows "Add to Cart for Price", Amazon shows no featured offer (a "High price" banner and "0 options with no featured offers"), and Tool Nut's price is script-loaded and absent from the server HTML. products.provenance: Model identity confirmed as the exact SP6000J1 kit (6-1/2 in. plunge saw + 55 in. guide rail + stackable case): Amazon and Coastal Tool carry the full title "Makita SP6000J1 6-1/2" Plunge Circular Saw Kit, with Stackable Tool case and 55" Guide Rail" and Tool Nut explicitly states "Model Number: SP6000J1" — not the bare SP6000J saw or the older SP6000K1 variant. Specs were extracted verbatim from Coastal Tool and Tool Nut (authorized Makita dealers) and Amazon: corded 12 A motor (Coastal "Amperage: 12.0"; Amazon "Current Rating 12 Amps"), 6-1/2" blade, variable 2,000-5,200 RPM (Amazon spec table "Speed 5200 RPM"), bevel -1 to 48° with stops at 22.5°/45°, and a magnesium saw at 9.7 lbs net (Coastal "only 9.7 lbs"; Tool Nut "Makita lists the saw at only 9.7 lbs"); Amazon's 16.5 lb is the kit/shipping weight, so the tool-only 9.7 lb figure is used per the catalog's weight convention. No numeric US price appears on any fetched page, so priceUsd is null; brushless status and release year are not stated on any fetched page, so both are null. The manufacturer page (makitatools.com/products/details/SP6000J1) was not directly reachable from this environment, but every published value is carried verbatim on the Coastal Tool corroboration page.
